policy_extraction.implementation_notes: This document is a practical contract checklist published by METI in February 2025, aimed at businesses engaging in AI utilization and development. It is non-binding guidance to assist businesses—especially those unfamiliar with AI legal practice—in reviewing contract terms related to inputs, outputs, personal data handling under Japan's Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI), security, and log retention. It references the 'AI事業者ガイドライン' (AI Business Operator Guidelines v1.01, November 2024) and the prior 2019 'AI・データの利用に関する契約ガイドライン'. No penalties or enforcement authorities are named; the document is purely advisory.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The document is primarily framed around protecting business users (consumers/enterprises) from legal and data-handling risks when contracting for AI services. It explicitly cites concerns about legal risks not being properly examined and data being used for unexpected purposes or provided to third parties causing unforeseen harm. While innovation enablement and economic competitiveness are mentioned as context, the checklist's core purpose is risk management and protection of data subjects and contracting parties—a consumer/public safety framing. Fundamental rights (personal data protection under Japan's APPI) appears as a strong secondary frame.
